claims.claim_text: Captions provide text for speech and relevant non-speech audio information in synchronized media.
claims.limitations: Captions address auditory information; they do not by themselves convey all visual information.

claims.claim_text: When important visual information is not conveyed through the main audio, audio description or another appropriate text alternative can provide access to that visual information.
claims.page_or_section: Description of Visual Information; WCAG 2.2 SC 1.2.3 and 1.2.5
claims.population_context: Prerecorded synchronized media; people who cannot adequately access visual information
claims.limitations: The appropriate alternative depends on the media type and the information that must be conveyed; this is not a universal requirement for every video in exactly the same form.

claims.claim_text: A descriptive transcript can combine auditory and visual information and can support a wider range of access needs.
claims.limitations: A descriptive transcript is an alternative format; it is not identical to captions and should not be presented as a universal substitute for every accessibility method.

decision.notes: Production claims are mapped to authoritative W3C/WAI sources. The episode must not claim that captions are useless or sufficient for every audience; wording must remain media-context dependent.
